dm-assistant.description: D&D 5.5e Dungeon Master co-pilot — runs sessions, tracks world state, manages NPCs and encounters

story-weaver.description: Generates branching narrative paths based on player decisions and world state

newsession.description: Start a new session log with context from previous sessions
newsession.template:
Create a new session log for today's D&D 5.5e session.

First, list all existing files in sessions/ to find the highest session number. The new file should be session-NNN.md where NNN is the highest existing number + 1, padded to 3 digits (e.g. 001, 002, 010).

Read the most recent session file, world/timeline.md, world/locations.md, world/factions.md, and world/branches.md for current world state and any open story branches.

Then create the new session file using the session-template.md format.

Players present: $ARGUMENTS

Set the scene based on where the party ended last session.

recap.description: Generate a narrated 'previously on...' recap for players
recap.template: Read the last 3 session files from sessions/ and world/timeline.md. Generate a dramatic narrated recap suitable for reading to players before the session starts. Keep it to 2-3 paragraphs. Focus on: where the party is, what they were doing, unresolved plot threads, and any major NPCs they interacted with.

storybranch.description: Generate branching story paths from recent player decisions
storybranch.template:
Read the most recent session file from sessions/, world/locations.md, world/factions.md, world/timeline.md, and world/branches.md. Collect the key player decisions, unresolved threads, current faction relationships, and known locations.

Then use the task tool to delegate creative generation to the story-weaver subagent. Pass it this context and instruct it to return 3-5 distinct story branches. Each branch should include: hook, immediate stakes, long-term implications, faction/NPC reactions, and DM notes.

Once the story-weaver returns the branches, write them into world/branches.md using the existing format. Mark all branches as Open. Record the session number and the player decision that triggered this branch set. Then confirm to the DM what was generated.

develop-npc.description: Generate a detailed NPC with personality, goals, and plot hooks
develop-npc.template:
Read world/locations.md and world/factions.md for context. Create a detailed D&D 5.5e NPC with:

Name: $ARGUMENTS

Include:
- Race, class (if any), appearance
- Personality traits, ideals, bonds, flaws
- Short-term and long-term goals
- How they connect to existing factions/locations
- 3 plot hooks involving this NPC
- Stat block reference (CR, key abilities)

Save to characters/npcs/{name}.md

create-pc.template:
Create a D&D 5.5e player character sheet for $ARGUMENTS.

First, read characters/pcs/pc-template.md for the format.
Then read any existing PC sheets in characters/pcs/ for style reference.

Generate a complete, playable level 1 character including:
- Chosen race, class, background, alignment
- Rolled ability scores (use python3 dice.py 4d6dl1 six times to generate stats)
- HP, AC, proficiency bonus, speed
- Saving throws, skills (mark proficient ones)
- Class features and racial traits
- Starting equipment and inventory
- Personality traits, ideals, bonds, flaws
- Brief backstory (2-3 paragraphs)
- Spellcasting section if applicable

Save the completed sheet to characters/pcs/{name}.md

save.description: Snapshot current campaign state to save/ directory
save.template: Read all session files from sessions/, all world state files (world/locations.md, world/factions.md, world/timeline.md, world/branches.md), and all character sheets from characters/. Create a comprehensive campaign snapshot as a JSON file in save/ named save_YYYY-MM-DD_HHMM.json. Include session count, active story branches with status, faction relationships, discovered locations, PC levels, and key NPCs.

combat.description: Run a combat encounter — initiative, turn tracking, damage, resolution

seed-world.description: Interactive campaign world seeding — fill out the campaign primer and propagate to world files

load.description: Restore campaign state from a save file
load.template: First, list all files in save/ and display them to the user with their timestamps. Ask which save file to restore. Then read that save file and use its contents to restore world/locations.md, world/factions.md, world/timeline.md, and world/branches.md to the saved state. Confirm what was restored.

status.description: Show current campaign status at a glance
status.template:
Read the most recent session file, world/timeline.md, world/locations.md, world/factions.md, and world/branches.md. Generate a compact DM-facing status summary including:
- Last session date and location
- Open story branches
- Faction standing changes
- Unresolved plot hooks
- PC levels and health status (if sheets exist)
- Any ticking clocks or time-sensitive situations

dm-help.description: List all available DM commands with descriptions

resolve-action.description: Guided action resolution — determines action type, sets DC, rolls, determines outcome

check.description: Quick ability check — pick a skill, set DC, roll, determine outcome

attack.description: Quick attack roll — target, roll to hit, roll damage, determine outcome

save.description: Quick saving throw — set DC, roll save, determine effect
